records.title: Merchandise adjustment
records.body: Marketplace orders qualify for reimbursement within fourteen days when the seal is intact and the seller approves the request.

records.title: Service bulletin appendix
records.body: For a marketplace product listed in a factory safety bulletin, send the serial number to the original seller for collection and repayment.

records.title: Voucher conditions
records.body: A marketplace promotional credit expires after thirty days and may be used by the original account holder.

records.title: Dispute queue
records.body: Claims about a seller response can be escalated to the marketplace mediation desk after seven days.

records.title: Receipt lookup
records.body: The marketplace portal can export an invoice for staff who know the original order reference.
